scope.summary: Implement genital region topology in the BASE mesh (spec 13.21; PREQ-011, REQ-029 foundation): vulva, penis, and anus regions live in the single base topology with no geograft seam anywhere, with toggleable genital-region SubD resolution (hero closeup density) and a censor toggle for SFW lanes.
acceptance_criteria: Base-mesh vulva, penis, and anus regions exist in the single base topology with edge loops supporting rigging and extreme gape (MT-485 topology contract: genital-region loops present); zero geograft seams.
Resolution toggle: genital regions carry a SubD-level override independent of the body level via the MT-487 cage architecture, enabling hero closeup density.
Censor toggle: typed config flattens/removes genital detail for SFW export lanes without altering vertex count/order, so all morphs stay compatible in both states.
Vulva/penis/anus region masks registered in the MT-486 authority; BODY_TOPOLOGY_VALID covers genital-loop presence.
scope.risk_if_missed: Geograft seams are the single biggest Daz genital pain (shell blending, texture mismatch, pose breakdown); if genitals are not in base topology from day one, every later skin, rig, and export MT inherits the seam problem PREQ-011 exists to eliminate.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
